The '''J-type diplomatic barge''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the royalty of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] for diplomatic transport. Designed by the [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]], the craft succeeded the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] as primary transport for Naboo's queen and royal entourage.

==Characteristics==
[[File:NabooCruiser-NEGVV.png|thumb|left|250px|A J-type diplomatic barge.]]
To remedy prior design flaws, the new vessel was fitted with improved deflector shield generators and multiple backup S-6 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] generators, ensuring [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] ability and crew safety while retaining the high speed and sleek aerodynamics that exemplified its predecessor. The vessel was also plated in shimmering chromium, similar to other Naboo diplomatic ships.

In accordance with Naboo custom for diplomatic ships, the barge was unarmed, instead relying on its high speed, powerful shields, and fighter escort to escape enemy fire. Because of the limited range of most escort fighters, the barge was equipped with four under-wing recharge sockets for use by [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] during long voyages.

Being a luxury vessel, the barge was equipped with many of the same amenities that marked other high-level diplomatic ships: spacious crew stations, four large luxury chambers, and six cabins for guards. The ship also had parlor rooms, where there was one or more [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]] boards.

==History==
[[File:Naboo_Royal_Cruiser_DB.png|thumb|left|250px|A J-type barge over Coruscant]]
The vessel was used to transport [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the day of the vote of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]]. The starship was destroyed seconds after landing by [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], in an attempt to assassinate the senator. Zam failed, because Senator Amidala used a decoy on the barge to fool any potential assassins. The Senator survived the attempt, having disguised herself as an escort fighter pilot, but her handmaiden [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé]] perished in the blast.
